extracted.intended_audience: anesthesiology educators, researchers, certification stakeholders, and those requesting ABA research data
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational research standards and practices used by the American Board of Anesthesiology to design, evaluate, and communicate certification assessments and related research. Covers goals for assessment quality, psychometric grounding, manuscript preparation, data access procedures, and alignment with strategic planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessments must be consistent, reliable and valid
rubrics_metrics.description: We are dedicated to providing assessments that are consistent, reliable and valid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is stated as the core commitment driving ABA research efforts; the organization uses research-based evidence to achieve these measurement properties for its certification instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rely on research-based evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: To achieve this, we rely on research-based evidence to foster innovation, make efficient use of our resources and uphold the highest standards in our field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research should be the evidentiary basis for decisions about assessment design and policy. The phrase implies prioritizing empirical studies, psychometric analyses, and literature to guide innovations and resource allocation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foster innovation through research
rubrics_metrics.description: Rely on research-based evidence to foster innovation...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research activities are expected to identify and support innovative approaches to certification and assessment (for example, virtual examinations, new assessment formats), as reflected by recent publications on virtual/APPLIED exams and milestone trajectories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make efficient use of organizational resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Rely on research-based evidence to... make efficient use of our resources...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research should inform resource allocation decisions (e.g., which assessment modalities to support), aiming for cost-effectiveness and efficient deployment of staff/time/infrastructure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uphold the highest standards in the field
rubrics_metrics.description: Rely on research-based evidence to... uphold the highest standards in our field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research and assessment practices should align with professional and scientific standards in anesthesiology and medical education, as demonstrated by publication in peer-reviewed journals and development of validated exams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ground research work in psychometrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Closely collaborating with the Research Committee, the psychometric and research team ensures that the work remains grounded by leveraging their expertise in psychometrics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should use psychometric principles and expertise (e.g., item analysis, test modelling) throughout design, evaluation, and interpretation of assessment outcomes; psychometric staff play an active role in shaping analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply analytic methodologies in research
rubrics_metrics.description: The team actively contributes to applying analytical methodologies...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research outputs should employ appropriate analytic methods (examples on the page include linear logistic test models, psychometric comparisons of formats, score-based tests) to examine item characteristics, pass-rates, and other assessment properties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Draft and refine manuscripts; ensure accurate and effective communication
rubrics_metrics.description: The team actively contributes to... drafting and refining manuscripts, ensuring the work is accurately and effectively communicated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research projects are expected to culminate in well-prepared manuscripts suitable for peer-reviewed publication; attention to clear, accurate communication of methods and findings is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Controlled access to research data via Data Request Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Interested in accessing our research data? Download the form below. Data Request Form
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data sharing is available but requires following the ABA's data request procedure (download and submit the form). This indicates a formalized process and likely review/conditions for access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use research to transform certification; align with Strategic Plan 2025-30
rubrics_metrics.description: Transforming the future of certification through research. 2025-30 Strategic Plan
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research is positioned to inform long-range strategic planning for certification (2025–2030), meaning projects should be aligned with organizational strategic goals and intended to drive future certification changes.
